new.n: Recluse Michael Tweit's rumored buried money, farm near Waldorf
new.pl: Waldorf (Waseca Co.); the farm was "near Waldorf", possibly over the line in Medo or Danville Twp (Blue Earth Co.); not yet placed
new.st: Michael Tweit, a recluse farmer and son of Thor Tweit (in Blue Earth Co. by about 1871, a well-off family), died 12 Jun 1927. His obituary says "it is generally rumored that he had buried money and hid it otherwise about his farm." A bank administered the estate and held an administrator's sale. No recovery was reported 1927-32. The pin marks Waldorf, not the farm.
new.t: Story only until the Tweit farm is placed on a 1914-1925 Waseca or Blue Earth Co. plat, then the farmstead on the 1938 aerial. Private land: ask permission first.
src: New Richland Star, 17 Jun 1927, p. 3 (obituary; newspapers.com 1025176059) and 24 Jun 1927, p. 3 (administrator's sale)
pinev: Town of Waldorf only; the farm is not placed
